prompts.text: A Mediterranean courtyard with blue tiles, lemon trees and a stone fountain, warm editorial photograph.
A monumental blue aquarium filled with sharks and rays, cinematic underwater light.
A grand retro-futurist railway station, clocks, glass arches and travelers.
Delicate botanical engraving with white flowers, cyan leaves and dark ink.
